outcome: Continuous positive pressure ventilation in the delivery room
Continued hospitalization at 40 weeks postmenstrual age
cohort: A cohort of 7,036 moderately preterm infants (29 0/7-33 6/7 weeks gestational age) from 18 centers, comparing those born to insulin-dependent diabetic mothers with those born to non-diabetic mothers.
finding: Moderately preterm infants born to insulin-dependent diabetic mothers were larger at birth, required more respiratory support, and experienced a higher risk of patent ductus arteriosus and prolonged hospitalization compared to those born to non-diabetic mothers.
